reason: The cited evidence does not address ALD of Al2O3 on zirconium alloys or its oxidation behavior. E1 concerns a different HEA film, and E2 describes Al2O3 formation on a different coating system, not supporting the key premises about ALD application or performance on the specified substrate.
premises: ALD can deposit a conformal, dense 100 nm Al2O3 coating on zirconium alloy cladding.
A dense Al2O3 layer acts as an effective oxygen diffusion barrier at high temperatures.
The Al2O3 coating will reduce oxidation rates and maintain mechanical integrity of the cladding at ~800°C.
